film.title: Miami, Florida: The Badge on Campus (Part II)
film.description:
In 2025 Florida International University's campus police signed a 287(g) agreement with ICE. Students organized, stood up in T-shirts at an event with the president, and were disciplined for it. In August 2026 they sued, and on August 23 a federal judge ordered the university not to enforce the policy against them. The case is still open. This is part two of two. Part one, Owlcatraz, is here: https://youtu.be/EWtQcKFFuto

Narrated by Matthew Hagan. Gary Mercer and Whitey Ruiz are fictional AI anchors with AI voices and are not affiliated with any school. The narrator is real. The opening score is original. Closing music: Sunday Heatwave.

Local history... and college basketball. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com

Sources:
WLRN, April 15, 2025 and April 7, 2026
Caplin News (FIU); PantherNOW, November 21, 2025
Nonprofit Quarterly, October 16, 2025
Florida Phoenix, August 11 and August 24, 2026
National Constitution Center, August 27, 2026 (ICEBreakers v. Nunez, preliminary injunction of August 23, 2026)

Pictures: Miami photographs and video by Matthew Hagan. From Wikimedia Commons: FIU Parkview Housing by Jenstew2012 (CC BY-SA 4.0); FIU College of Law by Comayagua99 (CC BY 3.0); FIU College of Business Administration by BD2412 (public domain); FIU Graham Center atrium and interior by Eduardo Merille (CC BY-SA 2.0).

reels.title: The Badge on Campus, Part II: campus police and ICE
reels.text: In 2025 Florida's governor pressed public universities to sign their campus police up with ICE. FIU did. Part II, a minute from our new film, Miami, Florida: The Badge on Campus.

reels.title: The Badge on Campus, Part II: they got homework
reels.text: Seven FIU students stood up in T-shirts and said nothing. They were ordered to record a reflection video. In August a federal judge told the school not to enforce it, and the case is still open. Part II, a minute from our new film, Miami, Florida: The Badge on Campus.
